visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a muscular man wearing pink sunglasses and a black cap; he is shirtless and standing in a sunlit wooded area with green trees. A second person, visible from the chest down in a white long-sleeved shirt and yellow vest, is meticulously cleaning a significant red scratch on the man's upper arm using a cloth. (2) The camera pans to a close-up of the man's bare back, revealing several long, red, parallel abrasions that indicate a recent fall or scrape. The background remains the same outdoor setting with dappled sunlight filtering through the surrounding forest foliage. (3) The scene shifts to a wide shot of a vast, dry, grassy plain under a brilliant, clear sky with the sun shining intensely. Several people are visible in the distance, some riding white horses and others jogging along a dirt trail, creating a sense of a large-scale outdoor competition or race event. (4) The shirtless man is seen jogging towards the camera on the dirt trail, his facial expression showing concentration and effort as he periodically looks back. The environment is open and expansive with rolling hills in the background. (5) In a different part of the trail, a man wearing a yellow and white athletic jersey and blue shorts is crouched low to the ground on a rocky slope. He appears physically distressed, with his head bowed and hands on his knees, while the camera captures his struggle from a slightly high angle.

Suddenly, a second male voice with an American accent asks, 'You guys alright?', which triggers a shift as the Mandarin speaker replies 'Yeah' and then complains about pain. (2) A sharp sound of rhythmic breathing and muffled footsteps occurs as the audio environment shifts to suggest physical exertion during a run. The acoustic guitar continues at a moderate tempo, maintaining a consistent rhythm while subtle wind noise suggests an open outdoor environment. (3) A distinct, wet retching sound breaks the musical flow, marking a moment of physical distress for one of the characters. This is followed by the Mandarin speaker's voice returning to a narrative tone, explaining the situation while the background music swells slightly in volume but remains upbeat. (4) The phase concludes with the narrator's voice becoming more clear and projected, speaking over the continuous guitar track, while distant, indistinct environmental murmurs and the rustle of dry grass are briefly audible in the background mix.
